00095   inline vFloat VEC_MUL_OP(vFloat const& leftVec, vFloat const& rightVec)
00096   {
00097    vFloat returnVec;
00098    float *returnFloat = (float *) &returnVec;
00099    float *leftFloat = (float *) &leftVec;
00100    float *rightFloat = (float *) &rightVec;
00101    
00102    returnFloat[0] = leftFloat[0] * rightFloat[0];
00103    returnFloat[1] = leftFloat[1] * rightFloat[1];
00104    returnFloat[2] = leftFloat[2] * rightFloat[2];
00105    returnFloat[3] = leftFloat[3] * rightFloat[3];
00106    
00107    return returnVec;
00108   }
00109 
00110   inline vFloat VEC_ADD_OP(vFloat const& leftVec, vFloat const& rightVec)
00111   {
00112    vFloat returnVec;
00113    float *returnFloat = (float *) &returnVec;
00114    float *leftFloat = (float *) &leftVec;
00115    float *rightFloat = (float *) &rightVec;
00116    
00117    returnFloat[0] = leftFloat[0] + rightFloat[0];
00118    returnFloat[1] = leftFloat[1] + rightFloat[1];
00119    returnFloat[2] = leftFloat[2] + rightFloat[2];
00120    returnFloat[3] = leftFloat[3] + rightFloat[3];
00121    
00122    return returnVec;
00123   }
00124 
00125   inline vFloat VEC_SUB_OP(vFloat const& leftVec, vFloat const& rightVec)
00126   {
00127    vFloat returnVec;
00128    float *returnFloat = (float *) &returnVec;
00129    float *leftFloat = (float *) &leftVec;
00130    float *rightFloat = (float *) &rightVec;
00131    
00132    returnFloat[0] = leftFloat[0] - rightFloat[0];
00133    returnFloat[1] = leftFloat[1] - rightFloat[1];
00134    returnFloat[2] = leftFloat[2] - rightFloat[2];
00135    returnFloat[3] = leftFloat[3] - rightFloat[3];
00136    
00137    return returnVec;
00138   }

00232  inline void fft(DSPSplitComplex& outputBuffer, const float* const inputBuffer) throw()
00233  {
00234   ugen_assert(inputBuffer != 0);
00235   
00236 #ifdef UGEN_FFTW
00237   memcpy(transformBufferSamples, inputBuffer, fftSizeBytes);
00238   fftwf_execute(fftwPlan);
00239 
00240   float nyquist = transformBufferSamples[fftSize]; // remember nyquist val
00241   float *interleavedSamples = transformBufferSamples;
00242   // deinteleave
00243   for(int j = 0; j < fftSizeHalved; j++)
00244   {
00245    outputBuffer.realp[j] = *interleavedSamples++;
00246    outputBuffer.imagp[j] = *interleavedSamples++;
00247   }
00248   outputBuffer.imagp[0] = nyquist; // pack nyquist in
00249   
00250 #elif defined(UGEN_FFTREAL)
00251   fftReal->do_fft(transformBufferSamples, inputBuffer);
00252   memcpy(outputBuffer.realp, transformBufferSplit.realp, fftSizeHalvedBytes);
00253   memcpy(outputBuffer.imagp, transformBufferSplit.imagp, fftSizeHalvedBytes);
00254   
00255 #else
00256   static float scale = 0.5f;
00257   vDSP_vsmul(inputBuffer, 1, &scale, transformBufferSamples, 1, fftSize);
00258   vDSP_ctoz ((COMPLEX *) transformBufferSamples, 2, &outputBuffer, 1, fftSizeHalved);
00259   vDSP_fft_zrip (fftvDSP, &outputBuffer, 1, fftSizeLog2, FFT_FORWARD);
00260   
00261 #endif
00262  }

00272  
00273  inline void ifft(float* const outputBuffer, DSPSplitComplex const& inputBuffer) throw()
00274  {
00275   ugen_assert(outputBuffer != 0);
00276   
00277 #ifdef UGEN_FFTW 
00278   LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, fftSize);
00279   LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, fftSizeHalved);
00280   LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, fftSizeBytes);
00281   LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, fftSizeHalvedBytes);
00282   
00283   LOCAL_DECLARE(float * const, transformBufferSamples);
00284   LOCAL_DECLARE(DSPSplitComplex&, transformBufferSplit);
00285 
00286   float *interleavedSamples = transformBufferSamples;
00287   for(int j = 0; j < fftSizeHalved; j++)
00288   {
00289    *interleavedSamples++ = inputBuffer.realp[j];
00290    *interleavedSamples++ = inputBuffer.imagp[j];
00291   }
00292   transformBufferSamples[fftSize  ] = transformBufferSamples[1]; // nyquist
00293   transformBufferSamples[fftSize+1] = 0.f; // nyquist imag always zero
00294   transformBufferSamples[1        ] = 0.f; // DC imag always zero
00295   
00296   fftwf_execute(ifftwPlan);
00297   memcpy(outputBuffer, transformBufferSamples, fftSizeBytes);
00298 #elif defined(UGEN_FFTREAL)
00299   memcpy(transformBufferSplit.realp, inputBuffer.realp, fftSizeBytes);
00300   fftReal->do_ifft(transformBufferSamples, outputBuffer);
00301 #else
00302 // #ifdef UGEN_IPHONE
00303 //  cblas_ccopy(fftSize, inputBuffer.realp, 1, transformBufferSplit.realp, 1);
00304 // #else
00305 //  vScopy(fftSize, (const vFloat*)inputBuffer.realp, (vFloat*)transformBufferSplit.realp);
00306 // #endif   
00307   memcpy(transformBufferSplit.realp, inputBuffer.realp, fftSizeBytes);
00308   vDSP_fft_zrip (fftvDSP, &transformBufferSplit, 1, fftSizeLog2, FFT_INVERSE);
00309   vDSP_ztoc (&transformBufferSplit, 1, (COMPLEX *) outputBuffer, 2, fftSizeHalved);
00310 #endif  
00311  }

00364 #define TEMPSIZE 65536
00365 static float tempData[TEMPSIZE];
00366 
00367 inline void MultAndAdd(DSPSplitComplex& In1, DSPSplitComplex& In2, DSPSplitComplex& Out, const int VecLength) throw()
00368 {
00369  ugen_assert(VecLength > 0);
00370  ugen_assert(VecLength*4/2 <= TEMPSIZE);
00371   
00372  float Nyquist1, Nyquist2;
00373  Nyquist1 = In1.imagp[0];
00374  Nyquist2 = In2.imagp[0];
00375  
00376  In1.imagp[0] = 0.f;
00377  In2.imagp[0] = 0.f;
00378  
00379  Out.imagp[0] += Nyquist1 * Nyquist2;
00380  
00381  const int VecLengthX4 = VecLength<<2;
00382  
00383  DSPSplitComplex temp;
00384  temp.realp = tempData;
00385  temp.imagp = tempData + VecLengthX4;
00386  
00387  vDSP_zvmul(&In1, 1, &In2, 1, &temp, 1, VecLengthX4, 1);
00388  vDSP_zvadd(&temp, 1, &Out, 1, &Out, 1, VecLengthX4);
00389  
00390  In1.imagp[0] = Nyquist1;
00391  In2.imagp[0] = Nyquist2;
00392 }
00393 #elif !defined(UGEN_VFP) // && !defined(UGEN_NEON)
00394 inline void MultAndAdd(DSPSplitComplex& In1, DSPSplitComplex& In2, DSPSplitComplex& Out, const int VecLength) throw()
00395 {
00396  ugen_assert(VecLength > 0);
00397  
00398  vFloat *InReal1 = (vFloat *) In1.realp;
00399  vFloat *InImag1 = (vFloat *) In1.imagp;
00400  vFloat *InReal2 = (vFloat *) In2.realp;
00401  vFloat *InImag2 = (vFloat *) In2.imagp;
00402  vFloat *OutReal = (vFloat *) Out.realp;
00403  vFloat *OutImag = (vFloat *) Out.imagp;
00404  ZEROINIT
00405  
00406  float Nyquist1, Nyquist2;
00407  Nyquist1 = In1.imagp[0];
00408  Nyquist2 = In2.imagp[0];
00409  
00410  In1.imagp[0] = 0.f;
00411  In2.imagp[0] = 0.f;
00412  
00413  Out.imagp[0] += Nyquist1 * Nyquist2;
00414  
00415  for (int i = 0; i < VecLength; i++)
00416  {
00417   OutReal[i] = VEC_ADD_OP (OutReal[i], VEC_SUB_OP (VEC_MUL_OP(InReal1[i], InReal2[i] ZEROARG), VEC_MUL_OP(InImag1[i], InImag2[i] ZEROARG)));
00418   OutImag[i] = VEC_ADD_OP (OutImag[i], VEC_ADD_OP (VEC_MUL_OP(InReal1[i], InImag2[i] ZEROARG), VEC_MUL_OP(InImag1[i], InReal2[i] ZEROARG)));
00419  }
00420  
00421  In1.imagp[0] = Nyquist1;
00422  In2.imagp[0] = Nyquist2;
00423 }
00424 #endif
